about_the_game:
Enter the terror of your Last Summer.

A group of campers arrive at the Silent Lamb Camp three days early to prepare for the upcoming opening season. They party, swim in the lake, drink alcohol and just have a good time. By the light of the campfire, the dark history of a mysterious killer unfolds.

Hunt or be hunted.

Last Summer is an upcoming asymmetrical multiplayer horror game that places you in the hands of a malevolent killer or one of the unfortunate, but tenacious victims. As the killer, your priority is to ensure that no one is left standing at the end of your hunt. As a camper, work together with your team to escape the nightmare knocking at your doorstep.

Multiple ways to survive (or slaughter).

The fight for survival will never be the same. Every action has consequences and every glimpse of hope is judged by dynamic gameplay. Equip items to fight back the horror, access multiple escape routes, chase down your targets, or create art with your executions.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is an asymmetrical horror game with frequent graphical violence. Blood and gore are present, particularly during finishers, and violence is frequent.
